participants.name: Personal Customer
participants.description: The individual applying for a personal credit card. The primary actor throughout the journey. An existing bank customer (active Customer record in SVC-001) aged >= 18 and UK resident.

phase_interactions.description: Browses the bank's credit card product range. Selects a card product (ENT-024 CardProduct). Submits the application form providing: income details (income_declared), employment status, and optionally a requested credit limit. Reviews and accepts the pre-contractual information (CCA 1974 s56 adequate explanations, representative APR, SECCI). Provides explicit consent to a hard credit check.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Application received confirmation (EVT-040 triggers SVC-053 notification): application reference number, expected decision timeline (typically instant), reminder that a hard search footprint will appear on their credit file.

phase_interactions.description: Customer has no direct interaction at this phase. Automated eligibility checks and hard credit check are processed by SVC-003 and SVC-012. Customer receives no notification during processing — only after the decision is made at PH-025.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: None during PH-024. Decision notification follows at PH-025.

phase_interactions.description: Customer receives the credit decision. On approval: notified of assigned credit limit, APR, and next steps for card receipt and activation. On decline: receives CONC-compliant decline notice including decline reason summary, name of CRA used (CCA s157), right to request human review (UK GDPR Art. 22), signpost to FOS and MoneyHelper.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Approve path: in-app notification + email with assigned credit limit, APR, card product name, expected card delivery date, activation instructions. Decline path: in-app notification + email with decline reason summary, CRA name, signpost to FOS and MoneyHelper debt advice, right-to-know reference.

phase_interactions.description: Customer receives notification that their virtual card is available immediately in the banking app. Physical card will arrive in 3–5 business days. The virtual card is accessible via the secure in-app viewer (card details displayed within the PCI-compliant in-app CDE viewer — never cached by the app). Customer may set PIN via the app.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Card issuance confirmation: virtual card available now (with link to in-app viewer), physical card dispatch confirmation with expected delivery date (3–5 business days), PIN setup prompt, activation instructions for physical card.

phase_interactions.description: Customer activates the physical card on receipt. Preferred method: explicit activation via the banking app (SCA-authenticated with possession factor — push notification to registered device — and knowledge factor — PIN or biometric). Alternative: the card is activated implicitly on first use (first card-present or card-not-present transaction).
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Card activation confirmation: card is now active, credit limit confirmed, first statement date communicated, link to card management settings (freeze/unfreeze, travel notifications, spending alerts).

phase_interactions.description: Customer receives monthly statements and manages their credit card account. Makes minimum or full payments (via direct debit, app, or online banking). Reviews spending in app. May receive FCA-mandated persistent debt communications at 18, 27, and 36 months if persistent_debt_months thresholds are met.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Monthly: statement available notification (closing balance, minimum payment due, payment due date). Persistent debt (if triggered): FCA-prescribed communication at 18 months (encouragement to repay more), 27 months (repayment plan offer), 36 months (credit limit suspension warning). All persistent debt communications sent via durable medium (email + secure message; letter if paper preference).

participants.name: Credit Analyst (Manual Review)
participants.description: A trained credit analyst who reviews referred credit card applications (ALT-CC-001). Involved only when the automated decisioning engine returns outcome = 'refer'. Reviews the full application, credit report (via credit_assessment_reference), and income data. Makes approve or decline decision within 2 business days. Decision is documented with rationale for Consumer Duty audit purposes.

phase_interactions.description: Reviews referred CreditCardApplication (ENT-022, status = 'referred'). Accesses credit report via SVC-012 using credit_assessment_reference. Reviews income_declared and employment_status. Applies credit policy with appropriate discretion. Documents decision rationale. Updates ENT-022 status to 'approved' (with assigned_credit_limit) or 'declined' (with decline_reason_code).
tools_used: SVC-012 assessment viewer (requires authorisation — credit risk-only access)
